title: We are here, on the frontline of truth / against persecution
slide_intent: Show how a repeated declaration can connect two different concerns. The constant opening gives the reader a phrase to recognize as its ending changes.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can use the same campaign voice for statements about truth and opposition to persecution.
demonstration: Two vertically divided photographic panels pair the declaration about truth with a speaker and the declaration against persecution with a second portrait. Blue-on-black and black-on-pink headline treatments distinguish the two.
practical_value: Keep the opening words consistent when comparing issues, then place each ending on its own image.

content_islands.name: Speaker and declaration
content_islands.spec: Fill the left half with the speaker holding a sheet of paper. Place the blue headline block over the lower part of the image.

content_islands.name: Second scene
content_islands.spec: Fill the right half with the second photographic scene. Place the pink headline higher in the frame and keep its line breaks compact.
